The slowest send was 13.520 seconds late. Passive traced lock-to-timer durations varied from 5.956 to 12.313 seconds. On the slowest measured basket the lag accrued mainly before timer evaluation. The latest measured basket reached all four staggered deadlines within one cycle and sent all within 3.795 seconds. Use the observed phase timings as offline fixtures. A same-session deadline check must retain fresh ownership, bracket, time, side and de-duplication checks. The constituent startup and read durations and on-time P&L are unmeasured.

manager.findings: The four represented basket slices all lost money. The two SOL lots accounted for about 69 percent of the group loss. None of the decision windows had a READY coin. The final 15-minute matches had lower after-cost win rate and lower mean net. In the first 180 closes, 114 official 15-minute pairs moved from 27 to 22 winners and mean net fell by $0.04937197. The available 30-minute sample is still partial. Nearby orders in the same baskets share price conditions.
